title: Before you cleaned up your life…
paragraphs: Before you cleaned up your life…
Jesus went to the cross for you.

"But God demonstrates His own love for us in this:
While we were still sinners, Christ died for us."
— Romans 5:8
You were loved before you changed.
You were chosen before you were perfect.
You were redeemed before you felt worthy.
Your identity was never based on your past.

If you're thankful for God's mercy today,
comment AMEN.
